Cost.description:
Token usage of the stage-2 call, and its money cost when the operator
priced the model in `profiles/schema.py::ModelConfig`.

`amount` and `currency` are both absent from the wire form when the
operator did not configure a price -- the tokens are still worth
reporting, the money is not (see
docs/superpowers/service/specs/response-cost-reporting.md). This whole
field is absent from the response, not merely `null`, whenever stage 2
was not called: `allow` from stage 1 and `allow` from the cache cost
nothing to compute, which is a different fact than "we didn't count."

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens the provider billed for the stage-2 call.
input_tokens.title: Input Tokens

output_tokens.description: Completion tokens the provider billed for the stage-2 call.
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens

reasoning_tokens.description: Hidden reasoning tokens the provider billed, or `0` when the provider does not report them. A nonzero value while the model is configured with reasoning off means the setting did not take effect.
reasoning_tokens.title: Reasoning Tokens

amount.description: Money cost of the call at the operator's configured price; absent when no price is configured for this model.
amount.title: Amount

Cost.title: Cost

DecisionKind.description: The three possible answers. All of them are delivered with HTTP 200: `deny` and `ask` are decisions, not errors.
DecisionKind.title: DecisionKind

LatencyMs.description: Per-stage timing of one decision. A stage that did not run is `null`.

stage1.description: Milliseconds spent in stage 1, or `null` if it did not run.
stage1.title: Stage1

stage2.description: Milliseconds spent in stage 2, or `null` if it did not run.
stage2.title: Stage2

total.description: Total milliseconds the service spent on this decision.
total.title: Total

LatencyMs.title: LatencyMs

description: The gate's answer to one proposed action.

decision.description: The gate's answer. Always delivered with HTTP 200.

reason.description: Text handed to the agent verbatim as the tool result. Always present and non-empty for `deny` and `ask`; an empty string for `allow`.
reason.title: Reason

suggest.description: A safe alternative to show the user. Empty string when there is nothing to suggest.
suggest.title: Suggest

stage.description: Who decided: `1` deterministic stage 1, `2` the LLM classifier, `0` an allow-cache hit or an API-level refusal such as an invalid body.
stage.title: Stage

rule_id.description: Identifier of the stage-1 rule that fired (`hard-deny.exfil`, `profile.path`, `allowlist.readonly`, `escalation`, …), or `null` when stage 2 decided.
rule_id.title: Rule Id

model.description: Name of the model configuration used, if stage 2 ran; `null` otherwise.
model.title: Model

latency_ms.description: Latency per stage and in total.

cached.description: True when this answer came from the per-session `allow` cache. Only `allow` is ever cached; `deny` and `ask` never are.
cached.title: Cached

decision_id.description: ULID of the stored decision. Stable identifier for the record in the database and in the JSONL log.
decision_id.title: Decision Id

protocol.description: Protocol version of this response. Always `1` in this release.
protocol.title: Protocol

cost.description: Token usage and money cost of the stage-2 call. Absent when stage 2 did not run.

title: DecideResponse
